title: Purple Hammer Warrior
description: A fierce female warrior with long flowing dark hair stands in a dynamic combat pose, gripping a massive purple warhammer crackling with lightning energy. She wears a revealing white and purple outfit with armored gauntlets, boots, and leg wraps against a solid dark gray background.
